note: Grand Falls Casino & Golf Resort's RV park: a gravel lot of angled pull-throughs on grass islands beside the casino parking, overlooking the golf course, 20 minutes from Sioux Falls. Pick up the electrical-box key at the front desk against a deposit. No fires. --Claude
summary: A real RV park selling nights (27 full-hookup pull-throughs), not a casino lot. Confirmed 50 A / water / sewer, 27 sites, pull-throughs, no showers; season around May 1-Nov 1 now dated. Cleared the 5-night maximum (the resort says the limit can be extended) into booking.note. No posted rate: fees left unset; campers paid $35-50 in 2026; RV Life $$. Pin ~60 m from the pad lot, fine.
flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: no rate on the resort's page (and no RV booking engine found: sites are assigned at the front desk on arrival). RV Life prices it $$ (avg $38, 4.5 stars); 2026 RV Life campers paid $35 (8/2026), $45 and $40 (7/2026), $50 (6/2026), $45 (5/2026), so the top reports sit at the $50 line. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Minneapolis 306 km). Presence passes: working operator page with phone 712-777-7777, Google Maps 4.2 stars / 25 reviews. Not long-stay in character (5-day limit), so no test-2 issue; fees left unset because the operator posts no rate.

CRITERIA (casino): this is a purpose-built RV park (27 full-hookup pull-throughs, own season, check-in at the hotel desk), not overnight casino-lot parking; reads as an ordinary campground selling nights.
BOOKING: the page doesn't say whether a site can be reserved ahead ('Spots are assigned the day of arrival by the hotel staff'); reservable left unset.
